notes: Comparative architectural library contrasting Semantic Router Studio (TypeScript/Node ONNX e5-small-v2 + MCP stdio + External RAG Webhooks + ChatGPT OAuth PKCE) with Torrent-RAG-UAGL (Python asyncio TRINITY FAISS + SQLite 4-tier SDCK + BitTorrent 256KiB P2P swarm + UAGL 3.0 R4 ForceVector/TESSA governance). Use this library as a blueprint for bridging TRINITY FastAPI (:7700) as an External RAG Connector or MCP tool target.

comparisonMatrix.semanticRouterStudio: TypeScript / Node.js 22 + React 19 Vite SPA + Express (:3000) + standalone MCP stdio CLI.
comparisonMatrix.torrentRagUagl: Python 3 asyncio microservices: FastAPI RAG (:7700), BitTorrent Tracker (:6969), UAG3 TCP Broker (:9000), P2P Wire TCP.
comparisonMatrix.sharedPattern: Unified central orchestrator decoupling transport ingress from embedding & retrieval logic.

comparisonMatrix.semanticRouterStudio: HTTP REST + EventSource SSE (:3000) + newline JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio (stdin/stdout) with PassThrough UI bridge.
comparisonMatrix.torrentRagUagl: FastAPI REST (:7700) + HTTP Tracker (:6969) + zlib length-prefixed P2P TCP + 74B+ UAG3 binary frames (:9000).
comparisonMatrix.sharedPattern: Dual-ingress philosophy: human/dashboard HTTP API alongside machine-to-machine agent wire transport.

comparisonMatrix.semanticRouterStudio: Xenova/e5-small-v2 (ONNX 384d, query:/passage:) + local 256d projection + BM25 lexical alpha blending.
comparisonMatrix.torrentRagUagl: SentenceTransformer all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384d) + SHA-512 hash fallback + FAISS IndexFlatIP + kappa score blending (0.7/0.3).
comparisonMatrix.sharedPattern: 384-dimensional normalized float32 dense vectors with deterministic zero-dependency hash/projection fallback.

comparisonMatrix.semanticRouterStudio: Dual System Instructions (Embedding templates + ChatGPT system/extraction prompts) + per-route overrides + safety guardrail routes.
comparisonMatrix.torrentRagUagl: UAGL 3.0 R4 ForceVector (g1..g4) stateful session chaining, V1..V10 manifold tracking, and TESSA ALLOW/MONITOR/ISOLATE gates.
comparisonMatrix.sharedPattern: Pre-execution semantic policy layer shaping and gating inference before final target execution.

comparisonMatrix.semanticRouterStudio: Pull-based external HTTP/HTTPS Webhook & URL fetchers (JSONPath, HTML-to-text, overlap chunking) scoped by route bindings.
comparisonMatrix.torrentRagUagl: Push POST /ingest + BitTorrent-style 256 KiB PieceCache bitfields + Kademlia DHT & P2P peer gossip.
comparisonMatrix.sharedPattern: Chunked text retrieval returning scored top-K citations ([1..K]) formatted directly for LLM prompt grounding.

comparisonMatrix.semanticRouterStudio: JSON state snapshot (router-state.json) + in-memory E5 vector Map cache + persistent Library Knowledge store.
comparisonMatrix.torrentRagUagl: SQLite (trinity_metadata.db) + FAISS vector index + 4-tier lifecycle (HOT/WARM/COLD zlib/FROZEN) with hourly consolidation.
comparisonMatrix.sharedPattern: Hot in-memory caching layered in front of durable disk metadata and vector blobs.

comparisonMatrix.semanticRouterStudio: OpenAI OAuth2 + PKCE S256 (127.0.0.1:1455 loopback / device flow) + telemetry secret redaction.
comparisonMatrix.torrentRagUagl: BLAKE2b guardian_sign ("G3·HEX") per wire packet + 7-layer AST + Göktürk symbol UAGLObfuscator + Unix-style Permission masks.
comparisonMatrix.sharedPattern: Cryptographic verification bound to session/sequence identity before privileged model/storage actions.

comparisonMatrix.semanticRouterStudio: Millisecond hrtime.bigint() active/decay spans streamed via SSE to dynamic SVG node/port topology.
comparisonMatrix.torrentRagUagl: SQLite query_log + UAGL ASCII kbar/trace execution dumps + PEER_EXEC session broadcasts + Tracker /scrape stats.
comparisonMatrix.sharedPattern: End-to-end execution trace logging capturing latency, confidence/kappa scores, and transport status.
